_meta.title: Every distinct value of universities.country / opportunities.country in live ORYN data, checked against ISO 3166-1
_meta.method: SELECT DISTINCT country FROM universities UNION SELECT DISTINCT country FROM opportunities, both WHERE country IS NOT NULL, checked value-by-value against ISO 3166-1 and against lib/acquisition/normalize.ts's existing COUNTRY_ALIASES map.
_meta.purpose: Ready-to-use reference for backfilling country_entity_id once entity_type='country' is bootstrapped (15-country-city-entity-gap.md, RULE-ENTITY-020). Not exhaustive of every country ORYN might ever need -- only the 90 currently in live use.
_meta.arithmetic_note: An earlier draft of this file and of 15-country-city-entity-gap.md's prose stated the total as 88 (with 86 clean) -- a manual-counting error caught and corrected by re-deriving the count programmatically before publishing. Recorded here, not silently fixed, per this package's own verify-before-claiming discipline (see 09 Finding 6 for another example of the same discipline applied to a different miscount).

non_standard_values.issue: Not a country at all -- a deliberate ORYN modeling choice for opportunities open worldwide (08-opportunity-organizer-canonicalization.md)
non_standard_values.recommendation: Must never receive a country_entity_id. Either leave country_entity_id null for these rows, or (better, longer-term) add a separate is_global/not_country_scoped flag rather than overloading the country text column with a non-country sentinel value.

non_standard_values.found_in: universities.country (3 rows: Eastern Mediterranean University, European University of Lefke, Near East University)
non_standard_values.issue: ISO 3166-1 has no code for Northern Cyprus at all -- only Turkey recognizes it as a sovereign state; ISO and the UN both treat the territory as part of Cyprus.
non_standard_values.recommendation: Needs an explicit decision before bulk-bootstrapping entity_type='country', not a silent default: (a) create a non-ISO country entity for it anyway, matching what ORYN's own live data already does, or (b) map these 3 universities' country_entity_id to Cyprus's ISO entity and preserve the Northern-Cyprus distinction elsewhere (city/notes field). This package does not choose for whoever implements it.
